title: Self-adjointness of coordinate projection
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $\pi$, and suppose there is a finite nonempty index set $\iota$ and a basis of the real-valued functions on $\Omega$ that contains the constant-one function and is orthonormal for the inner product weighted by $\pi$. For any natural number $n$, any $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and any functions $f,g:\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$, the product inner product weighted by the product distribution induced by $\pi$ satisfies $\langle f,P_Jg\rangle=\langle P_Jf,g\rangle$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite nonempty index set $\iota$ with decidable equality
A basis vector is the constant-one function
Basis is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product
